question: Do they demonstrate why interdisciplinary insights are important?
title: How we do things with words: Analyzing text as social and cultural data
answer_rationale: The documents emphasize that interdisciplinary insights and collaborations are essential for realizing the full potential of computational text analysis, especially when dealing with social and cultural concepts. This is explicitly stated in Text 1 and Text 9, which argue that bridging disciplinary divides leads to more fruitful work.
